details.description: Un escalon de la escalera esta doblado y se tropieza al subir las escaleras
Seen a pin without a keeper
Everything went good
I noticed that 4 way hook was missing clip on part
Tongs were hanging too low to make up shoe track
Driller was coming down too fast and wanting yo set slips on the fly.
Rig hand Picking hydraulic hoses up with rope
Billy's crew did an excellent hand over when making relief on the rig floor. Each crew member took time to explain where they were at in the process before jumping in to take over. Great job.

Crew was drilling down casing with external CRT. They were using the air hoist to pull back the nails and elevators so that they could drill down completely. While driller kicked the bails back I noticed a crew member holding onto the ear of the elevator before he installed the air hoist chain onto the elevators.
While doing service on the rig I noticed a pin/ bolt was broken on the cylinder that raises the mast
Roughneck was standing in between st80 and drill pipe
Hand was tighting the hoses on the tongs with shackle
Shackle missing keeper

The rig was slippery and too small 
Gaining a nice experience on casing
Ropes were installed on the elevator door to facilitate opening, and on the lifting lug to improve mobility
Everything Went good nobody got hurt
Mucho lodo en el piso

No pones en los chacos

longer tong springs an heavier should be remove from tong to avoid a heavy tong spring swing around or jump with tong motion as you making up pipe could potentially hurt tong operator or floorhand when pulling tongs   ( or we need to ask patterson to make there tong deadline shorter for us to actually use a rated tong spring for out heavier tongs)
The railings on the staircase were slick
While driller was coming down with casing halfway  heard load pop then heard something metal hit ground, immediately stopped job to look around and noticed handle from elevator had broken off
Be sure to get up and get dressed and be ready for the safety meeting that starts at 7 every morning , if not you'll get a rude awakening.
